notes.title: Lives added! OUT NOW ON MOBILE! (GOOGLE PLAY STORE!)
notes.content:
GET THE MOBILE VERSION HERE!
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.TegridyMadeGames.Pinball
1. Lives counter added!
2. You now get 3 lives!
3. Bonus ball is now set to 40 score per extra ball!
4. Score now set to 10 points per target to make achievements possible!
Cheers and have fun!

notes.title: OUT NOW ON MOBILE! Google Play Link Added! Lives Added, Score Increased!
notes.content:
OUT NOW ON MOBILE! Google Play Link Added!
1. Endless Furry Pinball 2D is OUT NOW! LINK: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.TegridyMadeGames.Pinball
2. Google Play Link added in game.
3. UI has been cleaned up a bit.
4. Deleting local high-score is now on main menu with a "Are you sure?" yes/no check.
5. Post processing added (will improve in the future!)
6. Camera effects now play when your ball hits a target furry!
7. Bonus ball is now set to 40 score per extra ball!
8. Score now set to 10 points per target to make achievements possible!

Visit the Google Play Link NOW here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Tegridy+Made+Games
